Manage and resolve approximately incidents, undertaking effective troubleshooting and fault resolution. Implement configuration changes, standard changes and operational service requests in line with agreed change processes. Complete monthly patching activity, ensuring operational readiness and alignment with maintenance schedules. Process web access requests and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure requests are progressed accurately and efficiently. Your Skills And Experience Experience supporting enterprise web proxy server infrastructure within a network environment, including day-to-day administration, operational maintenance and service stability. Hands-on experience supporting Clearswift Web Gateways, including configuration, administration, troubleshooting and operational support. Strong Red Hat Linux skills, with the ability to support server maintenance, monthly patching, operational readiness checks and infrastructure troubleshooting. Proven ability to manage and resolve network and infrastructure incidents, carrying out effective fault diagnosis, troubleshooting and service restoration. Experience implementing configuration changes, standard changes and operational service requests through controlled change processes. Knowledge of web access administration, including processing access requests, applying policy changes and coordinating with stakeholders to progress requests accurately. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. Your wellbeing You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more. Shared energy You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way. Why should you consider Capgemini? Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is. About Capgemini Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

The position oversees enterprise infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, Microsoft technologies, end-user support, and data center operations. Provide strategic and operational recommendations to the CITO. Build collaborative relationships with City departments, executive leadership, vendors, and external partners. Lead special projects and initiatives, as assigned. Department Leadership Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop IT managers and staff, including: Manage workforce planning, performance management, and employee development. Establish service level agreements (SLAs), customer service standards, and IT service management (ITSM) processes. Standardize technology support, device management, and end-user experience across the organization. Foster a culture of customer service, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. IT Operations Lead the daily operations of the Office of Information Technology & Services, including: Develop annual operating plans, performance measures, and service standards. Ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing technology services. Establish operational policies, procedures, and technology standards. Oversee disaster recovery and business continuity planning. Enterprise Technology Provide leadership for the City's enterprise technology environment, including: Enterprise infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, cloud services, Microsoft technologies, and data centers. Enterprise applications supporting General Fund and Public Safety operations. Cybersecurity program, including security monitoring, vulnerability management, identity management, endpoint protection, and incident response. Help Desk, Desktop Support, and Field Services teams. Technology modernization, lifecycle replacement, and operational improvements. Technology projects, implementations, and system upgrades. Financial & Vendor Management Manage the operating and capital budgets, as appropriate. Support department budget planning and long-term technology investment planning. Oversee operational relationships with technology vendors and service providers. Support technology procurement, contract negotiations, and vendor performance management. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Experience leading enterprise IT operations, technical teams, technology projects, budgets, and vendor relationships. Supplemental Information Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications (ITIL, PMP, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, Azure, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent). Experience in government or another large, complex organization. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Enterprise IT operations and service delivery. Infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, enterprise applications, and cloud services. Leadership, organizational development, and project management. Budgeting, vendor management, and contract administration. Strong communication, analytical, and decision-making skills. Working Conditions Work is performed primarily in an office environment with occasional visits to City facilities and data centers. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you. WHAT YOU'LL DO As a Senior Security Engineer on the Enterprise Security team, you'll protect Braze employees, their assets, and work locations using various tools and technologies. Your responsibilities include investigating malware and advanced threats, implementing DLP in a variety of solutions, securing SAAS applications, hardening internal configurations, proposing security architecture enhancements, and developing alerts & reports. In this role you will build, maintain, and document essential security infrastructure operating at the center of cloud operations, product, app security, and system architecture. That includes developing and enforcing policies, collaborating with other business units to enhance SIEM capabilities, and reviewing business partner technologies for security improvements. This role allows for collaboration with technical stakeholders to further expand upon forensics, Threat investigations, Malware investigations, IAM, SSO, MDM, password management, and vulnerability remediation. Take charge of securing communications, facilitating compliance, and deploying automation. You'll operate independently and collaboratively to implement protective systems and mentor junior associates in security concepts. As a senior team member, you'll help build functionality for a high-scale, growing customer base, collaborate with diverse security professionals, address unique security challenges, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to critical incidents. On-call rotation and working with Security and Engineering resources to help respond to critical incidents and escalations is an active part of this role. Responsibilities: As a Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise security, your primary focus will be to Design, implement, and manage security solutions to protect Braze’s users and infrastructure You will need an in-depth understanding of enterprise networking, architecture, and modern user & cloud tech stack. You will be responsible for taking an active role in developing, facilitating, and implementing security infrastructure designed to scale with the organizations growing needs You will need an in-depth understanding of enterprise networking, architecture, and modern user & cloud tech stack. You will be responsible for taking an active role in developing, facilitating, and implementing security infrastructure designed to scale with the organizations growing needs You will need to be adaptable. drive security initiatives You will have the freedom to implement automation systems to assist in detections and reporting, and be responsible for prioritizing ingestion and maintaining system technology footprint You will be working with a team of security professionals from varied backgrounds to solve first-in-industry security challenges and fill the use cases of our organization You will also be a part of an on-call rotation and work with Security and Engineering resources to help respond to critical incidents and escalations regarding your responsible domain This role is a key decision maker regarding internal product and system deployments Guide and perform security activities including vulnerability testing and analysis, design and implementation of new solutions/features and investigation into security events Ensure teams are implementing applications/environments in compliance of defined security policies based on risk avoidance and security best practices Make recommendations on toolset and process modifications and improvements and production IT security support Perform the Evaluation and Recommendation of current and future technology solutions to mitigate risk to the business Participate in documentation and adherence to Security Policies and Operating Procedures WHO YOU ARE Qualifications: 5+ years of Security Engineering experience with a strong focus on enterprise security, network security, endpoint security 3+ years of experience working in a corporate security organization/environment with hands on, technical, user facing stack and protecting SaaS applications. Direct technical and hands on experience with securing Email, Mac endpoints, IAM, Crowdstrike EDR, Enterprise networking security ( both endpoint and infra ), and forensics Conduct end-to-end security reviews of SaaS applications, data flow analysis, Technical architecture, authentication and authorization controls, and contractual security requirements, to ensure third-party tools meet organizational security standards Lead the design, implementation, and continuous tuning of forensics, programs across endpoints, networks, and cloud environments, including policy development, incident triage, data classification alignment, and cross-functional collaboration to prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data Bonus: Cloud security experience AI security Technical Security Certifications that delve deeper than high level concepts For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $128,900 and $180,000/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $143,200 and $200,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company. WHAT WE OFFER Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as: Competitive compensation that may include equity Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans Flexible paid time off Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® ABOUT BRAZE Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences. The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. Braze was also named a 2026 Best Places to Work by Built In, a 2025 America’s Greenest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®. review_candidates.title: Technisch Consultant Security (Cisco / Fortinet)
review_candidates.location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
review_candidates.description: Dit bieden wij jou Bij Axians helpen we organisaties om hun digitale weerbaarheid te vergroten. We adviseren over securitystrategie, ontwerpen beveiligingsoplossingen en implementeren technologieën die organisaties beschermen tegen de cyberdreigingen van vandaag én morgen. Als Technisch Consultant Security speel je een sleutelrol binnen complexe securitytrajecten. Je combineert technische diepgang met een adviserende rol en helpt klanten bij het maken van de juiste keuzes op het gebied van cyber security. Je werkt samen met consultants, architecten en engineers aan uitdagende projecten voor organisaties waar continuïteit, veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid essentieel zijn. Daarnaast bieden we: Een salaris, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring, tussen de € 5.000,- en € 6.500,-; Een winstdeling op basis van behaalde bedrijfsresultaten; 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om meer dagen op te bouwen; Een premievrije pensioenregeling; Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget; De mogelijkheid gebruik te maken van onze Lease a Bike regeling; Laptop en telefoon van de zaak; Hybride werken met als standplaats Capelle aan den IJssel; Veel ruimte voor opleidingen, certificeringen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling; Specialistische collega's om mee te sparren; Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Senior Consultant, Solution Architect of Security Architect; Onbeperkt toegang tot OpenUp voor ondersteuning op het gebied van mentale gezondheid en welzijn. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat collega's zich zowel professioneel als persoonlijk kunnen ontwikkelen. Daarom investeren we continu in kennisdeling, certificeringen en een werkomgeving waarin fysieke én emotionele veiligheid centraal staan. Hier krijg jij energie van Als Technisch Consultant Security ben jij de schakel tussen business, cyber security en technologie. Je helpt organisaties bij het vergroten van hun digitale weerbaarheid door risico's inzichtelijk te maken, securitystrategieën te ontwikkelen en beveiligingsoplossingen succesvol te ontwerpen en implementeren. Binnen ons Cyber Security team werken consultants, architecten, engineers en securityspecialisten dagelijks samen aan complexe securityvraagstukken binnen enterprise omgevingen. Wij ondersteunen klanten gedurende de volledige security lifecycle: van risicoanalyse, security assessments en architectuurvraagstukken tot implementatie, optimalisatie, monitoring en incidentrespons. In jouw rol combineer je technische diepgang met een sterk adviserend vermogen. Je adviseert klanten over moderne securityarchitecturen, voert security assessments uit en vertaalt bedrijfsdoelstellingen naar toekomstbestendige beveiligingsoplossingen. Daarbij werk je onder andere met technologieën en platformen zoals Fortinet, Cisco Security, Next Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Network Access Control (NAC), Identity & Access Management (IAM), SIEM, IPS, WAF, Zero Trust en cloud security-oplossingen. Je bent betrokken bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van complexe securityoplossingen en ondersteunt klanten bij vraagstukken rondom netwerkbeveiliging, toegangsbeheer, segmentatie, threat protection en security governance. Daarnaast deel je actief jouw kennis binnen het team, verzorg je technische workshops en draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe securitydiensten en innovatieve oplossingen. Wij geloven dat effectieve cyber security verder gaat dan technologie alleen. Daarom kijken we niet alleen naar producten en configuraties, maar juist naar risico's, processen, compliance-eisen en de strategische doelstellingen van onze klanten. Zo help je organisaties niet alleen veiliger te worden, maar ook toekomstbestendig te blijven in een continu veranderend dreigingslandschap. Ons team groeit snel, maar behoudt bewust zijn persoonlijke karakter. De lijnen zijn kort, kennisdeling staat centraal en collega's helpen elkaar graag verder. Je krijgt veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en vertrouwen om impact te maken bij klanten, terwijl je altijd kunt terugvallen op een team van ervaren consultants, architecten en engineers die dezelfde passie voor cyber security delen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Adviseren over cyber security strategieën en securityarchitecturen; Ontwerpen en implementeren van Cisco- en Fortinet-securityoplossingen; Uitvoeren van security assessments, risicoanalyses en technische reviews; Implementeren van NGFW-, NAC-, IAM-, SIEM-, IPS- en WAF-oplossingen; Begeleiden van security verbetertrajecten en incidentanalyses; Verzorgen van kennissessies, workshops en klantpresentaties; Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en vertalen van innovaties naar nieuwe dienstverlening. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent een ervaren securityprofessional die techniek weet te combineren met adviesvaardigheden. Je vindt het leuk om klanten mee te nemen in jouw visie en complexe vraagstukken om te zetten naar concrete en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Je hebt bijvoorbeeld ervaring als: Technisch Consultant Security; Security Consultant; Senior Security Engineer; Cyber Security Consultant; Security Specialist; Network Security Engineer; Security Architect (junior/medior). Daarnaast beschik je over: HBO werk- en denkniveau; Minimaal 6 jaar ervaring binnen IT, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar in een vergelijkbare consultancyrol; Ervaring met de implementatie van Next Generation Firewalls; Ervaring met complexe netwerkomgevingen en protocollen zoals MPLS, OSPF en BGP; Ervaring met oplossingen zoals SIEM, IPS, WAF, Antivirus, Antispam en NAC; Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden richting klanten en stakeholders; Een proactieve houding en ondernemerschap. Een certificering op het niveau van Fortinet NSE7, Cisco CCNP Security of een vergelijkbare kwalificatie is een sterke pre. Dit is jouw team Binnen ons Cyber Security team helpen we organisaties dagelijks om hun digitale weerbaarheid te vergroten. We brengen risico's en kwetsbaarheden in kaart, adviseren over passende beveiligingsmaatregelen en implementeren oplossingen die organisaties beschermen tegen de cyberdreigingen van vandaag én morgen. Onze expertise bestrijkt het volledige securitydomein: van preventie en beveiligingsarchitectuur tot detectie, respons en herstel. We helpen klanten bij het beschermen van hun netwerken, data, systemen en gebruikers, monitoren potentiële dreigingen en ondersteunen organisaties bij het beheersen van securityrisico's. Wij zijn een team van consultants, architecten, engineers en securityspecialisten met een gezamenlijke passie voor cyber security. Samen ontwikkelen we maatwerkoplossingen die aansluiten op de risico's, ambities en bedrijfsdoelstellingen van onze klanten. Daarbij combineren we technische diepgang met een pragmatische aanpak en adviseren we organisaties over de juiste balans tussen veiligheid, continuïteit en innovatie. Ons team groeit hard, maar behoudt bewust het persoonlijke karakter. De lijnen zijn kort, kennisdeling staat centraal en collega's helpen elkaar graag verder. Zo combineren we de kracht van een gespecialiseerde securityorganisatie met de betrokkenheid van een hecht team waarin je alle ruimte krijgt om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
